Which languages it says it can answer in
The day we read that directory

notChecked.en: How skilled any individual doctor is
Whether this hospital is better than another

axes.looksEn: Interpreters and which languages · how long replies take · whether a named desk actually exists
axes.looksKo: 통역 인력과 언어 · 문의 응답 시간 · 담당 창구가 실제로 있는가
axes.evidenceEn: Measured, not declared — reply times come from the record, not a form
axes.evidenceKo: 서류가 아니라 실측 — 회신까지 걸린 시간을 기록에서 읽는다

axes.fearEn: I signed something I could not read.
axes.looksEn: Whether the procedure and its cost are given in writing beforehand · whether risks and alternatives are stated · whether consent happens in the patient's language
axes.looksKo: 시술 설명과 비용을 사전에 문서로 주는가 · 부작용과 대안을 알리는가 · 동의 절차가 환자 언어로 이뤄지는가

axes.fearEn: I went home and could not reach anyone.
axes.looksEn: How you are contacted after you fly home · what happens if a complication appears · whether records are sent to your own doctor
axes.looksKo: 귀국 후 연락 체계 · 합병증 발생 시 대응 · 진료 기록을 본국 의료진에게 전달하는가

axes.fearEn: The bill was not the number I was told.
axes.looksEn: Cost disclosed up front and the rule for anything added · how a dispute is handled · whether advertising stays inside the regulations
axes.looksKo: 비용 사전 고지와 추가금 규칙 · 분쟁 처리 절차 · 광고 표현이 규제를 지키는가
axes.evidenceEn: Documents plus a check of the hospital's own wording
